mob_map_icons.configuration.iconMode.too: Full body: the whole mob. Head and shoulders: a big head crop that stays readable on busy maps (flying and very wide mobs keep their full body). Chibi, head pin and top down ignore this.
mob_map_icons.configuration.iconStyle.to: Appearance applied before map textures are cached. Chibi and head pin use heads; top down uses the whole body.
mob_map_icons.configuration.rotateWithHe: Turn each icon to the way the mob faces (eight directions, rendered on demand). Off: every icon faces you. Off by default.
mob_map_icons.configuration.headingArrow: Small arrow on each icon pointing the way the mob faces
mob_map_icons.configuration.tintByHostil: Apply an additional hostile-red tint in FTB Chunks.
mob_map_icons.configuration.players.tool: Draw other players as their skin's model (FTB Chunks, JourneyMap). You are never touched.
mob_map_icons.configuration.farmMode.too: Merge nearby mobs of one kind. Named, leashed, tamed and boss mobs stay separate.
mob_map_icons.configuration.maxIcons.too: Draw nearest mobs first. Zero removes the icon count limit.
mob_map_icons.configuration.clusterRadiu: Screen-pixel distance within which farm-mode mobs merge.
mob_map_icons.configuration.clusterMinCo: Minimum mob count needed to form a farm-mode group.
mob_map_icons.configuration.blacklist.to: Entity type IDs excluded from icons, for example minecraft:armor_stand.
mob_map_icons.configuration.title: Mob Map Icons
Overrides for FTB Chunks only. Anything left on inherit follows the global options above.
mob_map_icons.configuration.section.xaer: Overrides for Xaero's Minimap and World Map only. Anything left on inherit follows the global options above.
mob_map_icons.configuration.section.jour: Overrides for JourneyMap only. Anything left on inherit follows the global options above.
Use Mob Map Icons in this map mod.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.iconStyl: Style for this map mod only. Inherit: use the global style.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.iconMode: Mode for this map mod only. Inherit: use the global mode.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.rotateWi: Inherit, on or off, for this map mod only.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.headingA: Inherit, on or off, for this map mod only.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.farmMode: Inherit, on or off, for this map mod only.
Draw other players as their skin's model in this map mod. Inherit, on or off.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.ownPlaye: Draw your own player with our icon and replace the map mod's own marker. Off by default. Other players are the Other players option. Not available for Xaero (its marker cannot be replaced without patching it).
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.xaeroSca: Fraction of Xaero radar cell occupied by each icon (0.25-1.0).
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.journeym: JourneyMap's own marker around each mob icon. Auto: hidden for self-contained styles (badge, head pin, silhouette, retro, chibi, paper ink); kept for the rest, with outline and shadow drawn plain inside it. On: always kept. Off: always hidden.
mob_map_icons.options.nativeXaero: Xaero: use its own settings screen
mob_map_icons.options.title: Mob Map Icons
mob_map_icons.configuration.iconSizeMini: Icon edge on minimaps, 8-64 pixels. Cached textures use twice this size. Replaces the single icon size of 0.4.3 and older.
mob_map_icons.configuration.iconSizeFull: Icon edge on full-screen maps (FTB Chunks' large map, JourneyMap's full-screen map), 8-64 pixels. Xaero uses one sprite for both of its maps, so it follows the minimap size.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.iconSize: Icon edge on this map mod's minimap, 8-64 pixels. 0: use the global minimap size.
Icon edge on this map mod's full-screen map, 8-64 pixels. 0: use the global full-screen size.
mob_map_icons.configuration.mod.autoIcon: JourneyMap draws its own dot or pin round our icons unless its Mob Display and Player Display are Icons. On: both are set to Icons (minimap and full-screen map) while this adapter is enabled; your previous values come back when the adapter is disabled or this is turned off.
